factor_value.evidence: inferred: Herein, we describe a novel, integrated approach that addresses this knowledge gap. This utilizes mass spectrometry-based chemical proteomics to characterize the global impact of an oncogene on the expressed kinome, and then functionally annotates the regulated kinases. As an example, we identified approximately one hundred protein kinases exhibiting altered expression and/or phosphorylation in Src-transformed mammary epithelial cells.
